title: Do not spend this rare life asleep
summary: The line gives purpose back to the day by refusing drift its usual authority. Let this stay near the next choice: let this stay with you: treat this life as rare enough to center it on Naam.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.

source.shortMeaning: A rare human life is squandered when it forgets Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before drift becomes another evening, remember what this life was given for.
